title: Delicious in Dungeon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a red dragon swallows their spellcaster Falin, her brother Laios and companions Marcille and Chilchuck rush back into the dungeon to save her before she is digested. Short on supplies, they survive by cooking the monsters they meet, guided by the dwarf Senshi.
life_message: A good life means caring for companions and living within the natural cycle of eating and being eaten.

content.note: Monster fights, deaths and revivals; a companion eaten by a dragon (Wikipedia); AniList Body Horror signal.
Dark turns and forbidden magic (to verify).

winners_losers: Patient, curious companions who respect the dungeon's ecology prevail; those who seek limitless power over life and desire lose (to verify). Sympathy goes to balance.
